svg.title: Four world map projections
svg.desc: A two-by-two comparison of Mercator, Peirce quincuncial, Gall–Peters, and Winkel Tripel projections, rebuilt from the current world.svg family with light country colours, light blue water, white country gaps, white Antarctica, white coordinate grids, and highlighted equators.
svg.metadata: Source-native composite of world.svg, world-peirce-quincuncial.svg, world-gall-peters.svg, and world-winkel-tripel.svg. Original geography derives from Mercator Projection.svg by Geordie Bosanko, CC BY-SA 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mercator_Projection.svg.
